description: Retrieval time versus real collection size (stage 6). Qwen not used.

configuration.questions: the 20 questions of data/evaluation_questions.json; each order uses the questions of its base story
configuration.cache: no caches in the exact engine; approximate character n-grams are precomputed during preparation (outside the timed searches); Levenshtein has no cache and runs inside the timed search
configuration.structures: each sub-collection has its own inverted index, vocabulary, document frequencies, content tokens and character n-grams
configuration.exact_engine_note: exact_search.INVERTED_INDEX and CHUNK_MAP are swapped for the sub-collection during its measurements and restored afterwards

definitions.candidates_considered: Exact: chunks proposed by the inverted index (at least one query term). Approximate: every chunk of the collection (no index is used).
definitions.chunks_examined: Chunks actually scanned (exact: with KMP or Z) or scored (approximate). No story filter is used here, so it equals the candidates.
definitions.chunks_matched: Exact: chunks with at least one exact match. Approximate: chunks with a score > 0 (character n-grams give almost every chunk a small score). Before top_k.
definitions.results_returned: Results returned after top_k (= min(chunks_matched, top_k)).
definitions.engine_reported_ms: retrieval_time_ms reported by the engine itself, from the start of the query processing to the ranked list.
definitions.wall_ms: Time measured around the call by this script.
definitions.collection_characters: Characters of original_text in the collection.
definitions.normalized_characters: Characters of normalized_text (what KMP and Z scan).
